down_walk.action: Straight FRONT fixed view. right_walk.action: Front-right THREE QUARTER fixed view matching DOG motion reference, BOTH eyes and chest visible. THREE poses: A near leg forward far leg back and near arm BACK; NEUTRAL both soles planted arms down; B far leg forward near leg back and near arm FORWARD. up_walk.action: Straight BACK fixed view. THREE poses: A own LEFT foot forward right arm forward; NEUTRAL both soles planted arms down; B own RIGHT foot forward left arm forward. Constant hand/torso position, feet alternate; tail never replaces arm. style: Copy accepted identity image exactly: head/body proportions, coat markings, brown eyes, ear shapes, clean dark outline and restrained cel shading. Two-legged compact SD animal, short arms legs, rounded paws with small digit lines. No clothes shoes props shadows lettering grids or environment. Reference motion image is POSE ONLY, never copy its species or colors. Brown bear: warm chocolate brown coat, tan oval muzzle, small ROUND ears, broad round head, wider sturdy compact torso, short round brown tail. No white chest or belly markings. All animals: NO paw pads, NO toe beans, NO internal circular/oval sole or palm markings, NO emphasized sole plane. Raised feet remain smooth in the local fur color. Retain normal open finger division lines. All directions, actions and portrait must match the approved front idle palette, line weight, cel shading and identity. No motion-specific coat hue, brightness or rendering changes. NO paw pads or toe beans.
